summary: Clearway kerb on busy Moggill Road at a junction; nowhere to stop.
reasons: No parked cars or parking lane

drivers.seclusion: Open junction in full view, dwelling 15 m from the kerb end.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs straight into traffic lanes at a signalised junction; no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Heavy arterial traffic, junction and bus lanes.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along the kerb; clearway signed Mon-Sat 7am-7pm.

sun_shade: Large tree shades the east side of the section in the morning.
